stories.title: Vitest Setup & Coverage Config
stories.spec:
## Acceptance Criteria
- `npm test` executa todos os testes
- `npm run test:coverage` executa com relatório de cobertura
- Build falha se cobertura < 85% em qualquer métrica (branches, lines, functions, statements)
- Configuração em `vitest.config.mjs` na raiz de `package/`

## Technical Approach
1. Instalar devDependencies: `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`
2. Criar `package/vitest.config.mjs`:
   - `test.environment: 'node'`
   - `coverage.provider: 'v8'`
   - `coverage.thresholds: { branches: 85, lines: 85, functions: 85, statements: 85 }`
   - `coverage.include: ['**/*.mjs', '!**/examples/**', '!**/tests/**']`
3. Adicionar scripts em `package/package.json`:
   - `"test": "vitest run"`
   - `"test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage"`
   - `"test:watch": "vitest"`

## Files to Touch
- `package/package.json` (adicionar devDependencies e scripts)
- `package/vitest.config.mjs` (criar)
